# STD-TEC-EKS-005: Networking

**Standards Metadata**

```yaml
standard_id: 'STD-TEC-EKS-005'
standard_name: 'EKS Networking'
standard_type: 'technology'
category: 'technology'
version: '1.0.0'
status: 'active'
compliance_level: 'mandatory'
tags: ['technology', 'eks', 'kubernetes', 'networking', 'vpc-cni', 'mandatory']
```

---

> Defines networking standards for Amazon EKS clusters within enterprise environments. Ensures secure, performant, and scalable network configurations for Kubernetes workloads with VPC CNI configuration, network policies, ingress management, and service mesh integration.

---
page_texts.3:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#purpose]

## Purpose

This standard establishes requirements for networking in Amazon EKS clusters to ensure secure, performant, and scalable network configurations for Kubernetes workloads.
page_texts.5:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#21-cni-plugin-settings]

### 2.1 CNI Plugin Settings

**VPC CNI Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: amazon-vpc-cni
    namespace: kube-system
data:
    enable-network-policy-controller: 'true'
    enable-pod-eni: 'false'
    enable-prefix-delegation: 'true'
    warm-prefix-target: '1'
    warm-ip-target: '3'
    minimum-ip-target: '2'
    disable-introspection: 'false'
    disable-metrics: 'false'
    disable-pod-v6: 'true'
```
page_texts.6:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#22-ip-address-management]

### 2.2 IP Address Management

**Subnet Planning**:

```yaml
# Node subnets (one per AZ)
nodeSubnets:
    - cidr: 10.0.1.0/24 # us-east-1a
      availableIPs: 251
    - cidr: 10.0.2.0/24 # us-east-1b
      availableIPs: 251
    - cidr: 10.0.3.0/24 # us-east-1c
      availableIPs: 251

# Pod IP allocation
podIPAllocation:
    strategy: 'prefix-delegation'
    prefixSize: '/28' # 16 IPs per prefix
    maxPodsPerNode: 110 # t3.large limit
```

**IP Pool Management**:

- **Warm Pool**: Maintain 3 ready IPs per node
- **Prefix Delegation**: Enable for efficient IP usage
- **IP Reclamation**: Automatic cleanup of unused IPs
page_texts.7:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#23-network-performance]

### 2.3 Network Performance

**CNI Performance Tuning**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: amazon-vpc-cni
    namespace: kube-system
data:
    # Performance settings
    node-port-support: 'true'
    annotate-pod-ip: 'true'
    disable-tcp-early-demux: 'false'
    enable-bandwidth-plugin: 'true'
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#31-default-network-policies]

### 3.1 Default Network Policies

**Deny All Ingress** (default security):

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: deny-all-ingress
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector: {}
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
```

**Allow Kube-System Access**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: allow-kube-system
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector: {}
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
    ingress:
        - from:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: kube-system
```
page_texts.10:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#32-application-network-policies]

### 3.2 Application Network Policies

**Microservice Communication**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api-policy
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-auth-api
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
        - Egress
    ingress:
        - from:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: fusion-gateway
              - podSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-api-gateway
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 8000
    egress:
        - to:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: fusion-db
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 5432
        - to:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        name: fusion-cache
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 6379
        - to: [] # Allow DNS
          ports:
              - protocol: UDP
                port: 53
```

**Cross-Namespace Communication**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: allow-cross-namespace
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-auth-api
    policyTypes:
        - Ingress
    ingress:
        - from:
              - namespaceSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        network-policy: enabled
              - podSelector:
                    matchLabels:
                        network-policy: cross-namespace
```
page_texts.11:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#33-external-access-policies]

### 3.3 External Access Policies

**Internet Egress Control**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: NetworkPolicy
metadata:
    name: allow-external-apis
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    podSelector:
        matchLabels:
            app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-auth-api
    policyTypes:
        - Egress
    egress:
        - to: []
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 443 # HTTPS only
        - to: []
          ports:
              - protocol: TCP
                port: 80 # HTTP (limited)
          namespaceSelector: {}
```
page_texts.13:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#41-aws-load-balancer-controller]

### 4.1 AWS Load Balancer Controller

**ALB Ingress Class**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: IngressClass
metadata:
    name: alb
    annotations:
        ingressclass.kubernetes.io/is-default-class: 'true'
spec:
    controller: ingress.k8s.aws/alb
```

**internal ALB**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
    name: fusion-public-ingress
    namespace: fusion-gateway
    annotations:
        kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTP": 80}, {"HTTPS": 443}]'
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: '443'
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/certificate-arn: arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:certificate/cert-id
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/security-groups: sg-alb-public
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/subnets: subnet-public-1a,subnet-public-1b,subnet-public-1c
spec:
    rules:
        - host: api.fusion.gainwell.com
          http:
              paths:
                  - path: /auth
                    pathType: Prefix
                    backend:
                        service:
                            name: fusion-auth-api
                            port:
                                number: 80
                  - path: /admin
                    pathType: Prefix
                    backend:
                        service:
                            name: fusion-admin-api
                            port:
                                number: 80
```

**Internal ALB**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.k8s.io/v1
kind: Ingress
metadata:
    name: fusion-internal-ingress
    namespace: fusion-gateway
    annotations:
        kubernetes.io/ingress.class: alb
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/scheme: internal
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/target-type: ip
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/listen-ports: '[{"HTTPS": 443}]'
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/certificate-arn: arn:aws:acm:us-east-1:ACCOUNT:certificate/internal-cert-id
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/security-groups: sg-alb-internal
        alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/subnets: subnet-private-1a,subnet-private-1b,subnet-private-1c
spec:
    rules:
        - host: internal-api.fusion.gainwell.com
          http:
              paths:
                  - path: /
                    pathType: Prefix
                    backend:
                        service:
                            name: fusion-internal-api
                            port:
                                number: 80
```
page_texts.14:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#42-ingress-annotations-standards]

### 4.2 Ingress Annotations Standards

**Security Annotations**:

```yaml
annotations:
    # SSL/TLS Configuration
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-policy: ELBSecurityPolicy-TLS-1-2-2017-01
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/ssl-redirect: '443'

    # Security Headers
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/actions.response-headers: |
        {
          "type": "fixed-response",
          "fixedResponseConfig": {
            "contentType": "text/plain",
            "statusCode": "200",
            "responseHeaders": {
              "X-Frame-Options": "DENY",
              "X-Content-Type-Options": "nosniff",
              "X-XSS-Protection": "1; mode=block",
              "Strict-Transport-Security": "max-age=31536000; includeSubDomains"
            }
          }
        }

    # Health Check Configuration
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-path: /health
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-interval-seconds: '30'
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthcheck-timeout-seconds: '5'
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/healthy-threshold-count: '2'
    alb.ingress.kubernetes.io/unhealthy-threshold-count: '3'
```
page_texts.16:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#51-istio-configuration]

### 5.1 Istio Configuration

**Istio Sidecar Injection**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Namespace
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth
    labels:
        istio-injection: enabled
        network-policy: enabled
```

**Virtual Service Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: VirtualService
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    hosts:
        - fusion-auth-api
    http:
        - match:
              - headers:
                    x-canary:
                        exact: 'true'
          route:
              - destination:
                    host: fusion-auth-api
                    subset: canary
                weight: 100
        - route:
              - destination:
                    host: fusion-auth-api
                    subset: stable
                weight: 100
```

**Destination Rule**:

```yaml
apiVersion: networking.istio.io/v1beta1
kind: DestinationRule
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api
    namespace: fusion-auth
spec:
    host: fusion-auth-api
    trafficPolicy:
        loadBalancer:
            simple: LEAST_CONN
        connectionPool:
            tcp:
                maxConnections: 100
            http:
                http1MaxPendingRequests: 50
                maxRequestsPerConnection: 10
        circuitBreaker:
            consecutiveErrors: 3
            interval: 30s
            baseEjectionTime: 30s
    subsets:
        - name: stable
          labels:
              version: stable
        - name: canary
          labels:
              version: canary
```

page_texts.19:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#61-coredns-configuration]

### 6.1 CoreDNS Configuration

**CoreDNS ConfigMap**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: coredns
    namespace: kube-system
data:
    Corefile: |
        .:53 {
            errors
            health {
                lameduck 5s
            }
            ready
            kubernetes cluster.local in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa {
                pods insecure
                fallthrough in-addr.arpa ip6.arpa
                ttl 30
            }
            prometheus :9153
            forward . /etc/resolv.conf {
                max_concurrent 1000
            }
            cache 30
            loop
            reload
            loadbalance
        }
```
page_texts.20:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#62-external-dns-integration]

### 6.2 External DNS Integration

**ExternalDNS Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
    name: external-dns
    namespace: kube-system
spec:
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: external-dns
    template:
        metadata:
            labels:
                app: external-dns
        spec:
            serviceAccountName: external-dns
            containers:
                - name: external-dns
                  image: k8s.gcr.io/external-dns/external-dns:v0.13.5
                  args:
                      - --source=service
                      - --source=ingress
                      - --domain-filter=fusion.gainwell.com
                      - --provider=aws
                      - --aws-zone-type=public
                      - --registry=txt
                      - --txt-owner-id=fusion-eks-cluster
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#71-network-load-balancer-nlb]

### 7.1 Network Load Balancer (NLB)

**NLB Service Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: Service
metadata:
    name: fusion-auth-api-nlb
    namespace: fusion-auth
    annotations:
        service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-type: 'nlb'
        service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-scheme: 'internal'
        service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-cross-zone-load-balancing-enabled: 'true'
        service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-nlb-target-type: 'ip'
        service.beta.kubernetes.io/aws-load-balancer-subnets: subnet-public-1a,subnet-public-1b,subnet-public-1c
spec:
    type: LoadBalancer
    ports:
        - name: https
          port: 443
          targetPort: 8000
          protocol: TCP
    selector:
        app.kubernetes.io/name: fusion-auth-api
```

### 8.1 Control Plane Security Groups

**EKS Control Plane SG**:

```yaml
# Inbound Rules
- protocol: HTTPS
  port: 443
  source: Worker Node Security Group
  description: 'Worker node access to control plane'

- protocol: TCP
  port: 10250
  source: Control Plane Security Group
  description: 'Control plane to worker node kubelet'

# Outbound Rules
- protocol: ALL
  port: ALL
  destination: 0.0.0.0/0
  description: 'All outbound traffic'
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#82-worker-node-security-groups]

### 8.2 Worker Node Security Groups

**Worker Node SG**:

```yaml
# Inbound Rules
- protocol: ALL
  port: ALL
  source: Worker Node Security Group
  description: 'Worker node to worker node communication'

- protocol: TCP
  port: 10250
  source: Control Plane Security Group
  description: 'Control plane to worker node kubelet'

- protocol: TCP
  port: 1025-65535
  source: Control Plane Security Group
  description: 'Control plane to worker node services'

# Outbound Rules
- protocol: ALL
  port: ALL
  destination: 0.0.0.0/0
  description: 'All outbound traffic'
```

### 8.3 Load Balancer Security Groups

**ALB Security Group**:

```yaml

- protocol: TCP
  port: 80
  source: 0.0.0.0/0

  port: 443
```

[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#91-vpc-flow-logs]

### 9.1 VPC Flow Logs

**Flow Log Configuration**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: vpc-flow-logs-config
data:
    destination: 'CloudWatch'
    logFormat: '${srcaddr} ${dstaddr} ${srcport} ${dstport} ${protocol} ${packets} ${bytes} ${start} ${end} ${action}'
    logRetention: '30'
    trafficType: 'ALL'
```
page_texts.30:
[standards/technology/eks/STD-TEC-EKS-005-networking.md#92-network-metrics]

### 9.2 Network Metrics

**CNI Metrics**:

```yaml
apiVersion: v1
kind: ConfigMap
metadata:
    name: amazon-vpc-cni
    namespace: kube-system
data:
    disable-metrics: 'false'
    enable-prometheus-metrics: 'true'
    prometheus-scrape-port: '61678'
```

**Service Monitor**:

```yaml
apiVersion: monitoring.coreos.com/v1
kind: ServiceMonitor
metadata:
    name: vpc-cni-metrics
    namespace: kube-system
spec:
    selector:
        matchLabels:
            app: aws-node
    endpoints:
        - port: metrics
          interval: 30s
          path: /metrics
```
